article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article101Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
Upon a judgment, including a foreign judgment, or a recognisance.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the judgment or recognisance.
